youtube.title: Mark Antony faked his fishing skills for Cleopatra 🐟 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Bro hired DIVERS to put fish on his hook to impress Cleopatra. She noticed. 🎣💀

The next day her divers put a salted fish on it in front of everyone.

Who fumbled harder? 👇 Tell us who should be in the next group chat.

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Plutarch's story of Antony and Cleopatra's fishing trip in Alexandria, around 41 BC.

#history #historymemes #cleopatra #markantony #ancientrome #ancientegypt #shorts
